verdict.rationale: stagewise auto-generates a WORKSPACE.md high-level project summary when a workspace is connected (stagewise-docs-20). Its agent can read files across multiple workspaces (stagewise-docs-1, stagewise-docs-5, stagewise-docs-25), and clicking a UI element attaches it as agent context, which helps locate the code behind a feature (stagewise-docs-10, stagewise-docs-13). However, these features are framed as giving the agent context, not as tooling that explains architecture to the developer. missing for 10: a documented developer-facing codebase explanation or Q&A workflow, architecture or dependency mapping, guidance on finding entry points for changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of codebase-understanding quality.
